derived_from: A get_product response harvested read-only from a test environment on 2026-09-27, with its names and labels replaced by neutral text, so this file is an illustration, not evidence. The field set and the versions array are as the platform returned them; the action types are edited to show a retired "list" button, which versions published before #1544 carry.
teaches: What get_product returns: { code, product, versions }. This stored version carries a "list" button, a type main has refused since #1544, so echoing it back through update_product can 400 where that change is deployed. Rebuild the body from create-product instead.
